description: This file implements a class for testing voice wake word detection using Apple's Speech framework, AVFoundation, and related utilities. It manages speech recognition sessions, processes audio input, detects specific trigger words, and logs debugging info.

classes.name: VoiceWakeTester
classes.description: A class responsible for managing voice wake word detection, speech recognition sessions, and associated states and logs.

methods.name: start
methods.description: Initiates speech recognition with specified triggers, microphone ID, locale, and update callback.

methods.name: finalize
methods.description: Ends recognition with optional timeout, completing current session.

methods.name: handleResult
methods.description: Processes recognition result, detects wake words, logs debug info, and updates UI state.

methods.name: maybeLogDebug
methods.description: Logs detailed debug info about recognition segments and match status.

methods.name: configureSession
methods.description: Configures audio session, placeholder for real implementation.

methods.name: logInputSelection
methods.description: Logs selected input device and microphone preferences.

methods.name: ensurePermissions
methods.description: Checks and requests microphone and speech recognition permissions.

methods.name: holdUntilSilence
methods.description: Maintains listening state until silence or timeout occurs.

methods.name: scheduleSilenceCheck
methods.description: Schedules a task to detect silence and trigger wake detection accordingly.
